newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX, Bell Atlantic talks with group end.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX, Bell Atlantic talks with group end.

text.p: Negotiations affecting the New York Public Service Commission's decision on whether to approve the Bell Atlantic Corp-NYNEX Corp merger have ended, a consumer coalition said Thursday.
The New York Citizens Utility Board said talks ended Thursday morning.

The group said in a release it plans to formally take the matter before the Public Service Commission, which it said ordered the talks to address concerns over service quality standards, rates and potential anti-competitive issues.
NYNEX issued its own statement, which said the merger approval process remains unchanged.
The negotiations were not crucial for approval, NYNEX spokesman Bob Varettoni said, noting that an impasse in talks between the parties "was anticipated all along."
The parties will instead put their arguments for or against the merger in briefs for the PSC to use in its ruling, NYNEX said. NYNEX said a ruling on the merger from the PSC is expected in February.
Five of the seven NYNEX states have either approved or left unopposed the proposed stock swap to combine NYNEX and Bell Atlantic Corp.
